mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_center_notice (center_notice_key, title, sub_title, content, link_url, image, icon, view_count, user_code, center_code, created_at) VALUES (#{centerNoticeKey}, #{title}, #{subTitle}, #{content}, #{linkUrl}, #{image}, #{icon}, #{viewCount}, #{userCode}, #{centerCode}, SYSDATETIME())
mapper.select: SELECT n.id AS id, n.center_notice_key AS centerNoticeKey, n.title AS title, n.sub_title AS subTitle, n.content AS rawContent, n.created_at AS createdAt, n.icon AS icon, n.link_url AS linkUrl, n.view_count AS viewCount, u.user_name AS userName FROM erp_center_notice n JOIN erp_user u ON n.user_code = u.user_code WHERE n.center_code = #{centerCode} ORDER BY n.created_at DESC;

SELECT n.id AS id, n.center_notice_key AS centerNoticeKey, n.title AS title, n.sub_title AS subTitle, n.content AS rawContent, n.created_at AS createdAt, n.icon AS icon, n.link_url AS linkUrl, n.view_count AS viewCount, u.user_name AS userName FROM erp_center_notice n JOIN erp_user u ON n.user_code = u.user_code WHERE n.center_code = #{centerCode} AND n.id = #{id} ORDER BY n.created_at DESC;

SELECT TOP(#{count}) id AS idx, center_notice_key AS noticeKey, title AS title, sub_title AS subtitle, content AS content, icon AS subicon, created_at AS sdate FROM erp_center_notice
ORDER BY created_at DESC;

SELECT id AS idx, center_notice_key AS noticeKey, title AS title, sub_title AS subtitle, content AS note, icon AS subicon, image AS imagepath, link_url AS linkurl, created_at AS sdate FROM erp_center_notice where id = #{id} ORDER BY created_at DESC;
